summary: Palmer Square Capital BDC Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a $0.03/share supplemental dividend for Q2 2026, payable July 13, 2026 to holders of record June 26, 2026. This is in addition to the base $0.36/share dividend. The supplemental dividend is paid from excess undistributed net investment income. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium is mentioned as this is a routine dividend declaration. The filing is a standard disclosure of a capital return event. Investors should monitor future quarters for recurring supplemental dividends.
